phrase.zh: 一根细线，把消息送向远方。
phrase.en: A fine branch carries a signal onward.

visual.zh: 树状神经分支在暗处相连，亮点沿路径延伸，把细胞交流化作一幅网络图。它不是某个人脑的神经显微图。
visual.en: Branching neurons connect in darkness while light moves along a path, turning cell communication into a network image. It is not a micrograph of anyone’s brain.

background.zh: 神经元通常由细胞体、接收信息的树突和传出信号的轴突组成。神经网络参与感觉、运动和记忆等活动；不能从一根画出的连线定位或读取一段具体记忆。
background.en: A neuron typically has a cell body, dendrites that receive signals, and an axon that carries signals onward. Neural circuits participate in sensation, movement and memory; a drawn connection cannot locate or read a particular memory.
